name: DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 13

function.text: DCAF13 is the approved symbol for DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 13. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in nuclear estrogen receptor binding; ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity; decidualization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Esophageal carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: DCAF13 encodes DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 13. Its functions include nuclear estrogen receptor binding and ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DCAF13 have been reported in breast carcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.
